title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.27734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. translated_title: AutoOntologyBench：一个面向任务驱动的智能体知识工程基准测试
translated_abstract: 基础模型智能体正日益超越软件工程（SWE）领域，扩展到自主科学研究，而获取和整合领域知识仍然是一个关键挑战。近期的工业进展越来越多地采用知识图谱和基于本体的语义层，将异构知识组织成可复用的表示形式。我们提出的问题是：自主智能体能否构建出帮助它们解决真实任务的本体？这些本体相比其他知识表示形式是否提供了可衡量的收益？现有基准要么孤立地评估本体的正确性，要么孤立地评估智能体的任务成功率，导致自主获取知识的价值这一问题悬而未决。因此，我们提出了AutoOntologyBench，这是一个任务驱动的基准测试，包含19,947个经过审核的任务，这些任务基于来自7个领域的18个真实世界知识源，并配有源原生验证。该基准涵盖应用、维修、组织和建筑等领域……
tldr: 该论文提出AutoOntologyBench，一个基于7个领域18个真实知识源、包含19,947个审核任务的任务驱动型基准，首次系统评估自主智能体构建的本体能否真正帮助解决实际任务并带来可衡量的收益。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks from 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, to evaluate whether autonomously constructed ontologies provide measurable benefits for solving real tasks.
